description: Source code implementing asynchronous UART backend for modem communication, including event handling, buffer management, and initialization functions.

methods.name: modem_backend_uart_async_is_closed
methods.description: Checks if the UART backend is closed by testing specific atomic bits in the state.

methods.name: modem_backend_uart_async_event_handler
methods.description: Handles UART events such as transmission complete, buffer requests, data received, and errors.

methods.name: modem_backend_uart_async_open
methods.description: Initializes UART reception, sets state bits, and notifies that the port is opened.

methods.name: modem_backend_uart_async_transmit
methods.description: Starts asynchronous transmission of data over UART if not already transmitting.

methods.name: modem_backend_uart_async_receive
methods.description: Retrieves received data from ring buffer.

methods.name: modem_backend_uart_async_close
methods.description: Aborts ongoing UART transmission and disables UART reception.

methods.name: modem_backend_uart_async_notify_closed
methods.description: Notifies that UART port has been closed.
